mapper.insert: /* siege_map.upsertSiegeMapMatch */ INSERT INTO siege_map_match ( match_id, siege_id, season_yyyymm, rating_id, match_type, match_start_time, match_finish_time, snapshot_count, first_snapshot_at, last_snapshot_at, crt_date, upt_date ) VALUES ( #{match_id}, #{siege_id}, #{season_yyyymm}, #{rating_id}, #{match_type}, #{match_start_time}, #{match_finish_time}, 0, to_timestamp(#{captured_at}), to_timestamp(#{captured_at}), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (match_id) DO UPDATE SET siege_id = EXCLUDED.siege_id, rating_id = EXCLUDED.rating_id, match_type = EXCLUDED.match_type, match_start_time = EXCLUDED.match_start_time, match_finish_time = EXCLUDED.match_finish_time, upt_date = NOW()
mapper.update: /* siege_map.incrementSnapshotCount */ UPDATE siege_map_match SET snapshot_count = snapshot_count + 1, last_snapshot_at = to_timestamp(#{captured_at}), first_snapshot_at = COALESCE(first_snapshot_at, to_timestamp(#{captured_at})), upt_date = NOW() WHERE match_id = #{match_id}
mapper.select: /* siege_map.selectLatestSnapshotHeader */ SELECT id, match_id, captured_at, war_rest_start_time, war_rest_finish_time, max_match_score, max_deck_count_per_member, max_attack_unit_count, source FROM siege_map_snapshot WHERE match_id = #{match_id} ORDER BY captured_at DESC LIMIT 1

/* siege_map.selectSnapshotBase */ SELECT base_number, base_type, guild_id, base_status, battle_start_time, construct_time FROM siege_map_snapshot_base WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshot_id} AND base_number = #{base_number} LIMIT 1

/* siege_map.selectBaseDefenseDecks */ SELECT d.deck_id, d.wizard_id, w.wizard_name, w.wizard_level, w.guild_id, d.win_count, d.lose_count, d.draw_count, d.total_count, d.winning_rate, d.total_win_count, d.total_lose_count, COALESCE(ds.status, da.status) AS deck_status, ds.defense_guild_id, ds.attack_guild_id, ds.attack_wizard_id, ds.battle_start_time FROM siege_map_base_defense_deck d LEFT JOIN siege_map_base_defense_wizard w ON w.capture_id = d.capture_id AND w.wizard_id = d.wizard_id LEFT JOIN siege_map_base_defense_deck_status ds ON ds.capture_id = d.capture_id AND ds.deck_id = d.deck_id AND ds.base_number = #{base_number} LEFT JOIN siege_map_base_defense_deck_assign da ON da.capture_id = d.capture_id AND da.deck_id = d.deck_id AND da.base_number = #{base_number} WHERE d.capture_id = #{capture_id} AND ( da.deck_id IS NOT NULL OR ds.deck_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.deck_id LIMIT 500

/* siege_map.selectBaseDefenseUnits */ SELECT u.deck_id, u.pos_id, u.unit_master_id, u.unit_level, m.kr_name, m.image_url FROM siege_map_base_defense_unit u LEFT JOIN monster m ON m.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text WHERE u.capture_id = #{capture_id} ORDER BY u.deck_id, u.pos_id LIMIT 1500

/* siege_map.selectSiegeMapBaseLayoutMaster */ SELECT l.game_base_number, l.castle_zone, l.slot_no, l.pos_x_pct, l.pos_y_pct, l.ring_kind, l.display_width_px, l.display_height_px FROM siege_map_base_layout l ORDER BY l.game_base_number LIMIT 50
/* siege_map.selectSiegeMapBaseImageMaster */ SELECT i.castle_zone, i.ring_kind, i.base_status, i.image_path FROM siege_map_base_image i ORDER BY i.castle_zone, i.ring_kind, i.base_status LIMIT 25
